ast.scope: Lexical source projection; no macro expansion or semantic resolution

cost.scope: The scope-specific cost statement within the invariant-and-cost document; no runtime speed measurement inferred.

obernants.scope: Non-column-zero %! excludes extraction. Unknown directives exclude ordinary test output. Calls filter excludes double-quoted text but does not exclude all comments or single-quoted strings; it is no parser proof.

Same blocks admit arbitrary non-%! implementation text and ignored directives; same call-name set admits many syntactic forms. Report status cannot reconstruct process stderr, only truncated first-error detail survives.
Current synthetic checks invoke blocks/calls/assigned only. No OCTAVE_TESTS/OCTAVE_OUT corpus discovery, subprocess measurement or external data is used.
Directory read failure returns silently, file read defaults empty. timeout124 takes precedence over crash then expected-error then normal success/assert/error. Process launch errors panic.
Scope names use HashSet membership; files sorted before processing. Expected-error pattern/id is stripped without matching actual error text.
Helper scans O(text bytes) plus accumulated prefix copies; external traversal and per-block subprocess limit ten seconds are unexecuted effects. Output memory grows with report rows.
